card1.title: OBD computer diagnostics
card1.text: OBD error code reading, engine and system condition check. Suitable for diesel, petrol, hybrid and electric vehicles.

card2.title: Full pre-purchase car inspection
card2.text: Comprehensive vehicle inspection: body with paint thickness measurement, engine, suspension, OBD diagnostics, mileage analysis, test drive. Documented report with photos.

travel.title: Travel fee
travel.text: Travel pricing depends on the car location and is always stated or agreed before the appointment is confirmed.
travel.free_zone: No travel fee applies within Kaunas city and up to 20 km from the Kaunas city boundary.
travel.rate: Outside this zone, a travel fee of €0.50/km may apply.
travel.calculation: The fee is calculated for a round trip from the Kaunas city boundary or another base location agreed in advance.
travel.custom: For long distances or non-standard locations, travel pricing is agreed individually before appointment confirmation.
